name: madrasah-camera-bridge
description: Standalone Node.js service that subscribes to Frigate's MQTT event topic and forwards motion/human/vehicle detections to POST /api/camera-bridge/event on the main madrasah-website server. See README.md — this is NOT part of the main app's npm install/build/check (docs/CCTV_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md, Phase 5: bridge lives outside the main codebase on purpose, same pattern as hardware-bridge/).
